body.p: Fanny Maude Wilson (1870-1946) set up Melbourne's first free kindergarten in the Baptist Mission hall in Bouverie Street.
We are curious to learn more about her life and what brought her specifically to work in Carlton.

div.head: Sources
div.p: Deborah Towns, "Wilson, Maud (1870 - 1946)", The Encyclopedia of Women and Leadership in Twentieth-Century Australia.
